business_problem: Deutsche Bank needed to review third-party vendors' documentary evidence against its control framework and regulatory expectations faster without removing expert judgement, because onboarding and periodic reviews required specialists to examine multiple evidence files and make documented risk decisions manually.
solution_summary: Deutsche Bank built TPRM AI in-house and deployed it in Global Procurement & Vendor Management in December 2025 to accelerate third-party risk reviews while preserving human decision rights. The cloud-based platform ingests documentary evidence supplied by vendors, including business continuity submissions that may arrive as four to five separate files, and processes the material through a sequence of specialized AI agents. One agent retrieves the relevant Deutsche Bank control questions, a second drafts answers from the evidence set, and a third proposes an assessment outcome with citations to exact source passages. Those suggested answers and cited outcomes are then served to human assessors, who validate the recommendations and make the final approval decision. The source does not name storage services, but it does describe a scalable human-in-the-loop document analysis workflow designed for transparent verification and reuse across additional risk assessment areas.

solution_components.name: TPRM AI
solution_components.role: Cloud-based in-house agentic AI platform that analyzes vendor evidence, retrieves control questions, drafts answers, and proposes cited risk assessment outcomes for human review.

data_flow: Third-party vendors submit documentary evidence to Deutsche Bank, sometimes as four to five separate files. TPRM AI ingests those files, retrieves the relevant internal control questions, drafts answers from the evidence, and generates a suggested assessment outcome with citations to exact passages. Human assessors then review the cited recommendation against the control framework and make the final onboarding or review decision.
integration_points: Deutsche Bank control framework and control questions
Global Procurement & Vendor Management human assessors
business_outcome: The platform reduced document review times, accelerated vendor onboarding and processing timelines, delivered cited recommended outcomes at around 90% accuracy versus human validation, and gives Deutsche Bank a scalable basis for handling higher assessment volumes with cost-avoidance potential while keeping trained humans in control.
metrics: A manual review would typically take around 30 minutes per evidence document.
